description: Corrected one representation-only defect without changing accepted values: the DisputeAttachment fileName pattern uses the non-ECMAScript inline flag (?i) before the extension group. In the vendor's Java regex dialect the flag applies case-insensitive (ASCII) matching from that point to the end of the enclosing group, so only the extension alternatives are affected. They become the exactly equivalent case classes for jpeg|tiff|pdf; the unaffected prefix, anchor, grouping, length limits and description are preserved.

context.description: The name of the attachment, including its filename extension. Supported filename extensions: **jpeg**, **pdf**, **tiff**.
